format_longbench_v2_question: format a LongBench-v2 question row into the official template prompt with choices A through D
extract_longbench_v2_answer: extract the multiple-choice answer letter from a model response string using regex patterns
test_format_compatibility: test that both official and alternative question formats produce valid formatted prompts
test_answer_extraction: test answer extraction against multiple response formats including parentheses, asterisks, and freeform text
main: run the complete LongBench-v2 validation suite including format, extraction, and accuracy tests
